Hi! Regarding SLOTPLAN-105: The design review notes I have specifically address empty intervals (start==end), stating they never overlap anything. For touching intervals like (540, 600) and (600, 660), the standard interpretation in scheduling is that they do NOT overlap since they share only a boundary point with no common duration. The test_overlap_cases expectation of False is likely correct. The regression test expecting True might be the one that needs adjustment. Can you check if test_regression_issue_77 was written before this design decision?
